flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi (cronservice): crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository (findNoticesForMhaNricUpload, findToppanNoticesForStage), framework/workflows/agencies/mha/{upload/helpers/MhaNricDataHelper,download/helpers/MhaNricDownloadHelper}, framework/schedulers/MhaDownloadJobsScheduler, framework/workflows/datahiveuenfin/services/DataHiveUenFinService, framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/{jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob,helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper} (RD1 e-reminder), framework/workflows/agencies/toppan/upload/{jobs/ToppanUploadJob,helpers/ToppanUploadHelper}, cron-schedules-prod.properties. Other repos: no code specific to this story.
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%). This 1-point story only refers to Epic OCMS8 (check and update particulars), so it is assessed through the MHA and DataHive jobs in ocmsadminprivateapi (the stale copy ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice/ at the repo root is not used as evidence). The story mentions DOS and Vault; the code uses MHA (NRIC) and DataHive (FIN/UEN), whether that is what DOS/Vault means: cannot verify from repo. The NRIC check through MHA exists and its cron is enabled in prod; the FIN/UEN check through DataHive is off in prod (cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false); the RD1 e-reminder is off in all environments (cron.notification.enabled=false) and its outcome is not a condition for the 2nd letter (the Toppan query does not read it). There is no hirer-specific filter: every query uses offender_indicator 'Y', so the hirer is included as the current offender. Tickets used: OCMS-DF-2026-177, OCMS-DF-2026-134, OCMS-DF-2026-130 (MHA, Closed), OCMS-DF-2026-180 (eNotification cron not yet active).
recommendation: Partial claim: the NRIC check through MHA, saving the new address, and RD2 notice selection exist; the FIN/UEN check through DataHive is off in prod and the RD1 e-reminder is off and not a condition for the 2nd letter. Ask URA to confirm the prod configuration

steps.step: OCMS checks whether the hirer has been sent the electronic reminder (referring to the 1st letter) or has opted out of electronic reminders
steps.detail: The eNotification job picks notices whose last_processing_stage is RD1 (also RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3) with offender_indicator 'Y' (the current offender, no owner/hirer distinction), drops id_no values in ocms_enotification_exclusion_list and notices that already have a send record at that stage (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1076-1167, exclusion 1131-1134; called from NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:162, opt-outs skipped 226-241). Partial because (1) cron.notification.enabled=false in dev/uat/prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236), so the job only runs by manual trigger; OCMS-DF-2026-180 (Closed) still says 'Awaiting eNotification cron to activate'. (2) The outcome of this check is not a condition for the 2nd letter: the Toppan query (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:584-614) reads neither the send records nor the exclusion list, so the e-reminder and the RD2 letter run independently. Exclusion list content (DB data) and property values in Azure: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: Hirer NOPOs with an NRIC whose next stage is RD2 are selected for the MHA particulars check (Epic OCMS8)
steps.detail: findNoticesForMhaNricUpload picks notices with next_processing_stage IN (RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3), next_processing_date <= tomorrow, suspension_type NULL, onod.id_type 'N' (NRIC), offender_indicator 'Y', not yet in ocms_nro_temp, and an ID that is not in ocms_hst (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:563-581; used by MhaNricDataHelper.java:81). Because the filter is offender_indicator 'Y' with no owner/hirer distinction, a furnished hirer is picked up when the notice is at RD2. The MHA upload cron is enabled in prod (cron.mhaupload.enabled=true, cron-schedules-prod.properties:105-106). OCMS-DF-2026-177 (Closed, Prod deployment) fixed matching MHA results against the offender indicator. Whether the enquiry file reaches MHA and its content: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: Hirers with a FIN or a company (UEN) are checked through DataHive (Epic OCMS8)
steps.detail: getNoticesForDataHiveProcessing picks notices at stage RD1-DR3 (including RD2) with id_type F or B and offender_indicator 'Y' (DataHiveUenFinService.java:221-246). But the second job 'DH UEN and FIN' is skipped when cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false (MhaDownloadJobsScheduler.java:103-107) and the value is false in cron-schedules-prod.properties:52 (comment: stays off until the DataHive view names are verified). A hirer with a passport (id_type P) is in neither the MHA nor the DataHive query. Results from DataHive: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The check result updates the hirer's particulars (MHA address and owner/driver data) used for the 2nd letter
steps.detail: MhaNricDownloadHelper writes the new address from the MHA result file as an mha_reg row, only for notices in the batch file and only for rows that are still the current offender (MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:760-790), then inserts new rows or bulk UPDATEs existing ones (1345-1356). Owner/driver data is only updated while offender_indicator is still 'Y' (837-840). An invalid address triggers TS-NRO so the notice does not get a letter (1182-1254). MHA defects already fixed on main: OCMS-DF-2026-134 (address of other notices overwritten), OCMS-DF-2026-130 (old address fields not cleared), OCMS-DF-2026-177 (no offender indicator check), all Closed. The OCMS-DF-2026-134 remark says the MHA cron is not yet on in Prod, while the repo properties have cron.mhaupload.enabled=true and cron.mhadownload.enabled=true; value in Azure and the content of the MHA response: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: After the update, the hirer NOPO is ready for the 2nd letter reminder (next stage RD2, due, not suspended, has a letter address)
steps.detail: findToppanNoticesForStage is called per stage (RD2 here) and selects next_processing_stage = stage, next_processing_date <= today, suspension_type NULL, offender_indicator 'Y', not an Advisory Notice (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:584-614; called from ToppanUploadHelper.java:1887 through ToppanUploadJob.java:248). Notices without a deliverable address are dropped (ToppanUploadHelper.java:2026-2050) and only those with letter_address = 'Y' continue (2372-2400; ToppanUploadJob.java:266). Delivery of the file to the vendor is assessed in OCMS11.32.
